name: 4-TME
summary: 4-Thiometaescaline (4-TME), also known as 3-ethoxy-4-methylthio-5-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of metaescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a methylthio group.

pharmacology.text: The drug has approximately 4 times the potency of mescaline, though its effects are very different.
